title: Custom 404 & Programmatic Navigation
description: Add a branded 404 page and use useRouter to add a 'Go Back' button that navigates to the homepage.
problemStatement:
## Goal
Enhance the blog app with a custom 404 page and a programmatic navigation button.

### Requirements
1. Create `pages/404.js`.
   - Render a friendly 404 message with an emoji.
   - Include a **Link** to the homepage (`/`).
   - Add a **button** that, when clicked, uses `useRouter` to navigate back to the previous page (`router.back()`).
2. Add a similar **'Go to Home' button** on the Blog index page that uses `router.push('/')` to demonstrate programmatic navigation.
3. Ensure the custom 404 appears when you visit a non‑existent URL like `/nonexistent`.
4. Test that the 'Go Back' button on the 404 page returns to the previous page (e.g., from an invalid URL back to wherever you came from).

### Note
- Import `useRouter` from `next/router`.
- The button must be inside the component to use the hook.
hints: The Blog index button can use `onClick={() => router.push('/')}`.
Remember to wrap the button text in a `<button>` element.
expectedOutput: Custom 404 page with a working 'Go Back' button. Blog index has a programmatic 'Home' button. All navigation works.
